title: 第十九章 玉足第二十章 大壮你太厉害了
content_zh:
王大壮发动三轮车，突突突地驶出了早市，在林婉仪的指引下，沿着县城外环的公路往南开了大约二十分钟，一座依山傍水的庄园出现在视野中。
半山水山庄。
庄园的规模不小，依山而建，层层叠叠，白墙黛瓦，颇有几分江南园林的韵味。
大门口立着一块巨大的景观石，上面刻着“半山水山庄”五个大字，笔力遒劲。
门口有保安值守，看到林婉仪的三轮车，先是愣了一下，然后连忙升起栏杆放行。
王大壮开着三轮车从侧门进入山庄，沿着一条水泥路绕到了后门附近的员工通道。
林婉仪从车上下来，踩着高跟鞋噔噔噔地走进一扇小门，不一会儿带出来两个穿着白色制服的年轻小伙子。
“小张小李，帮忙把这些水果搬下来过秤。”林婉仪吩咐道。
两个小伙子手脚麻利地把十二筐水果从三轮车上搬下来，一筐一筐地抬进员工通道旁边的一间库房里，然后拿出来一个电子台秤，开始逐筐称重。
小张一边称一边报数，小李在旁边拿笔记录，两个人配合默契，效率很高。
王大壮站在旁边看着，心里默默计算着总重量和总价。
林婉仪站在王大壮身边，偶尔跟他说几句话，问他这些水果是怎么种出来的、用了什么肥料，王大壮含糊其辞地敷衍过去，只说用的是祖传的土办法。
“橘子五筐，总共二百五十六斤。”小李报出了最终的数字，然后继续称番石榴，“番石榴第一筐，五十四斤……”
林婉仪拿出手机计算了一下，然后抬起头对王大壮解释道：“大壮，橘子二百五十六斤，三千八百四十块，番石榴是三千二百四十块，芒果四千二百六十块，加起来一共是一万一千三百四十块，你看看对不对？”
王大壮听到这个数字的时候，心脏狠狠地跳了两下。
他知道这批水果能卖不少钱，但没想到能卖到这个数——一万多块，比他之前估计的最好情况还要高出好几倍。
不过王大壮还是努力让自己看起来淡定一些，点了点头道：“林姐，没问题，就这个数。”
林婉仪转身走进员工通道，不一会儿又走出来，手里多了一个厚厚的牛皮纸信封。
她把信封递到王大壮手里说道：“你点一下，一万一千三百四十块，一分不少。”
王大壮接过信封，手指捏了捏那厚厚的一沓，手感沉甸甸的。

他打开信封口，抽出一沓崭新的百元大钞，粗略地看了一眼，然后塞回去，抬头对林婉仪咧嘴一笑道：“不用点了，我信得过林姐。”
林婉仪微微一笑道：“你这人倒是爽快。”
王大壮把钱小心地揣进贴身的口袋里，心里那股激动劲儿怎么都压不住。
一万多块钱，就这么到手了？
他从出门到现在，不过半天工夫，就赚了一万多块？这在以前简直是想都不敢想的事。
“林姐。”王大壮搓了搓手，试探着问道：“家里还有不少存货，果园里起码还有四五千斤没摘，你要是还需要的话，我明天继续送过来。”
林婉仪眼睛一亮，毫不犹豫道：“有多少要多少，只要品质要跟这批一样。”
“那必须的，一棵树上的果子，品质绝对一样。”王大壮拍着胸脯保证道。
同时，心里飞速盘算着，果园里至少还有四五千斤水果没摘，就算按平均每斤十八块算，全部卖出去就是七八万块。
content_en:
Wang Dazhuang started the tricycle and drove out of the morning market. Under the guidance of Lin Wanyi, he drove south along the outer ring road of the county for about 20 minutes. A manor surrounded by mountains and rivers appeared in view.
Banshanshui Villa.
The manor is not small in scale. It is built on the mountain with layers upon layers of white walls and black tiles. It has a bit of the charm of Jiangnan gardens.
There is a huge landscape stone standing at the gate, with the five characters "Banshanshui Villa" engraved on it with powerful writing.
There was a security guard at the door. When he saw Lin Wanyi's tricycle, he was stunned for a moment, and then quickly raised the railing to let it go.
Wang Dazhuang drove a tricycle into the villa from the side door and followed a cement road around to the employee passage near the back door.
Lin Wanyi got out of the car and walked into a small door with high heels. After a while, two young men in white uniforms came out.
"Xiao Zhang and Xiao Li, help move these fruits down and weigh them." Lin Wanyi ordered.
The two young men moved twelve baskets of fruits off the tricycle with quick hands and feet, and carried them one basket at a time into a warehouse next to the employee passage. Then they took out an electronic scale and began to weigh baskets one by one.
Xiao Zhang reported the numbers while weighing, and Xiao Li took a pen beside him to record. The two of them cooperated tacitly and were very efficient.
Wang Dazhuang stood aside and watched, silently calculating the total weight and price in his heart.
Lin Wanyi stood next to Wang Dazhuang, occasionally saying a few words to him, asking him how these fruits were grown and what kind of fertilizer was used. Wang Dazhuang was vague and perfunctory, saying that he only used native methods passed down from his ancestors.
"Five baskets of oranges, a total of 256 kilograms." Xiao Li reported the final number, and then continued to weigh the guava, "The first basket of guava, fifty-four kilograms..."
Lin Wanyi took out her mobile phone and calculated it, then raised her head and explained to Wang Dazhuang: "Dazhuang, oranges are 256 pounds, 3840 yuan, guava is 3240 yuan, mangoes are 4260 yuan, the total is 11340 yuan, do you think it is correct?"
When Wang Dazhuang heard this number, his heart beat hard twice.
He knew that this batch of fruits could be sold for a lot of money, but he didn't expect to sell it for this amount - more than 10,000 yuan, which was several times higher than the best-case scenario he had previously estimated.
However, Wang Dazhuang still tried to look calm, nodded and said: "Sister Lin, no problem, that's the number."
Lin Wanyi turned around and walked into the employee passage, and walked out after a while with a thick brown paper envelope in her hand.
She handed the envelope to Wang Dazhuang's hand and said, "Click it, it's eleven thousand three hundred and forty yuan, every penny is more."
Wang Dazhuang took the envelope and pinched the thick pile with his fingers. It felt heavy in his hand.
He opened the envelope, pulled out a wad of brand-new hundred-dollar bills, glanced at it briefly, stuffed it back, looked up and grinned at Lin Wanyi and said, "No need to click, I can trust Sister Lin."
Lin Wanyi smiled slightly and said, "You are quite cheerful."
Wang Dazhuang carefully put the money into his pocket, unable to suppress the excitement in his heart.
Just get more than 10,000 yuan?
From the time he left home until now, he has earned more than 10,000 yuan in just half a day? This was something that was simply unthinkable before.
"Sister Lin." Wang Dazhuang rubbed his hands and asked tentatively: "There is still a lot of inventory at home, and there are at least four to five thousand kilograms left unpicked in the orchard. If you still need it, I will continue to deliver it tomorrow."
Lin Wanyi's eyes lit up and she said without hesitation: "As long as the quality is the same as this batch."
"That's a must. Fruits from the same tree are absolutely of the same quality." Wang Dazhuang assured, patting his chest.
At the same time, I quickly calculated in my mind that there were at least four to five thousand kilograms of fruit in the orchard that had not been picked. Even if the average price was 18 yuan per kilogram, selling them all would cost 70,000 to 80,000 yuan.
